description: SecurityJournalV2 logical snapshot and transition known answers (SPEC-v2 §6.6). Each scenario starts at the genesis journal anchored in a fresh store. After each step the anchored head and the exact canonical snapshot must equal the expectation; a rejected step leaves both unchanged. Digests are SHA-384("ratify-protocol-security-journal-v2" || 0x00 || snapshot) in lowercase hex.

operations.apply_revocation_list: ApplyRevocationList(issuer_id, epoch, key, list, policy, now) committed as one transition
operations.apply_revocation_push: ApplyRevocationPush(issuer_id, epoch, key, push, policy, now) committed as one transition
operations.expect_changed: false when the operation is a canonical no-op and the head does not move
operations.import_negatives: import snapshot_b64 against head; it must be refused with expect_error_class. The invariant_ cases are canonical snapshots whose own digest is the head but which violate an invariant of SPEC-v2 §6.6
operations.migration: decode legacy_record_b64 (the version 1 alpha record), validate it under the alpha digest (SHA-384 of legacy_digest_input_b64), migrate it to version 2 at generation+1 with previous_digest = legacy digest; tampered_legacy_record_b64 must be refused
operations.record_key_role: RecordKeyRole(role, key) for a non-status role
operations.transition_negatives: import current_snapshot_b64 against current_head and next_snapshot_b64 against next_head (both import), then validate the transition from current to next (the check every journal store applies before CompareAndSwap commits next): it must be refused with expect_error_class

scenarios.name: roles_and_status_epochs
scenarios.description: non-status roles, a first status epoch, idempotent repeats, component reuse rejection, and an epoch transition

scenarios.name: status_reducer_transitions
scenarios.description: bootstrap, contiguous push, semantic duplicate, gap, reconciliation, and an epoch transition that keeps the deny union

migration.description: the reducer_transitions final state re-encoded as a version 1 alpha record

import_negatives.name: head_digest_mismatch
import_negatives.description: a canonical snapshot whose digest differs from the anchored head

import_negatives.name: head_generation_mismatch
import_negatives.description: a canonical snapshot whose generation differs from the anchored head

import_negatives.name: noncanonical_whitespace
import_negatives.description: insignificant whitespace makes a snapshot noncanonical even with a matching head

import_negatives.name: unknown_member
import_negatives.description: an unknown member is rejected

import_negatives.name: observations_out_of_compaction_order
import_negatives.description: observations not in compaction order are rejected

import_negatives.name: unsafe_integer_max_observed_sequence
import_negatives.description: the first max_observed_sequence is 9007199254740992, above 2^53-1

import_negatives.name: unsafe_integer_fork_sequence
import_negatives.description: the first fork_sequence is 9007199254740992, above 2^53-1

import_negatives.name: unsafe_integer_status_key_epoch
import_negatives.description: the first status_key_epoch is 18446744073709551615, above 2^53-1

import_negatives.name: member_name_case
import_negatives.description: the member issuers is spelled Issuers

import_negatives.name: null_array_element
import_negatives.description: the first accepted_cert_ids element is null

import_negatives.name: invariant_status_binding_without_status_role
import_negatives.description: the epoch 2 status-key binding has no matching status key-role binding

import_negatives.name: invariant_status_epochs_not_contiguous
import_negatives.description: the epoch 1 status-key binding is removed, so the issuer's epochs do not run contiguously from 1

import_negatives.name: invariant_component_shared_across_bindings
import_negatives.description: a second key-role binding with a different key ID reuses an existing binding's Ed25519 component digest

import_negatives.name: invariant_key_role_history_unsorted
import_negatives.description: key_role_history is not sorted by key_id

import_negatives.name: invariant_max_observed_sequence_below_floor
import_negatives.description: max_observed_sequence is lowered below the accepted floor and below the retained current-epoch observations

import_negatives.name: invariant_accepted_set_differs_from_snapshot
import_negatives.description: accepted_cert_ids contains an ID that neither the accepted snapshot nor an accepted push revokes

import_negatives.name: invariant_deny_union_shrunk
import_negatives.description: deny_union_cert_ids omits c4, which a retained observation revokes: the deny union never shrinks

import_negatives.name: invariant_deny_union_without_witness
import_negatives.description: deny_union_cert_ids contains c9, which no retained observation revokes

import_negatives.name: invariant_fork_without_reconciliation
import_negatives.description: fork_sequence is nonzero while reconciliation_required is false and no current-epoch observation is marked fork

import_negatives.name: genesis_with_predecessor
import_negatives.description: a genesis snapshot whose previous_digest is not all zeros

transition_negatives.name: generation_skipped
transition_negatives.description: the successor's generation is the committed generation plus 2

transition_negatives.name: predecessor_mismatch
transition_negatives.description: the successor's generation is the committed generation plus 1 but previous_digest names another snapshot

transition_negatives.name: generation_not_advanced
transition_negatives.description: the committed snapshot is offered as its own successor

transition_negatives.name: key_role_binding_removed
transition_negatives.description: the successor drops the verifier key-role binding: key-role history is append-only

transition_negatives.name: deny_union_shrinks
transition_negatives.description: the state after push 2 (deny union c1, c2) is offered as the successor of the state after push 4 (deny union c1, c2, c4): the deny union and the evidence for c4 would be lost

transition_negatives.name: rollback_to_earlier_epoch
transition_negatives.description: the epoch 1 state is offered as the successor of the epoch 2 state: it removes the epoch 2 status-key binding and rolls the status-key epoch back
